scores.evidence: There are three can-do objectives, and each is assessed two or more times with objectiveId: o1 by q1, q2, e1 and e2; o2 by q3 (apply), e3 (apply, new home-path case) and e4; o3 by q4, e5 and e6. The rebuilt e3 (`Read(~/.aws/**)` in user settings) now tests writing a rule for a new case.

hook-b1 sets a concrete scene in three sentences (an unknown repo, 「READMEのとおりに準備して」, a leftover `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` with API spelled out) and ends with 「何が起こりうるでしょうか。」. The ungraded multi-select q0 follows, and its explanation points ahead to 10-1, 10-2 and 10-5. There is no trivia or statistic.

Terms are defined before use: プロンプトインジェクション (s1-defs), VM (s1-practices), ワークスペースの信頼 and サンドボックス (s2-defs), クラウドセッション (s2-isolate), エフォート (s5-table). `--dangerously-skip-permissions` is now glossed in e1-b, `~/` and `//` are taught in s3-pitfall, and `/compact` cost is in s5-table. The prerequisites still leave out 第6回 and 第7回, although CLAUDE.md (q1-d, s3-lead, e6-c), スキル (e6-c) and サブエージェント (s5-table) come from them.

measure.mjs: 「prose 1735 (budget 1,200–2,400) · read 2356 · practice reading 1072 · questions 11 · est 17.0 min (must be ≤ 20; estMinutes 17)」, so estMinutes 17 matches, and strict lint is clean. s2 is still the densest segment (7 blocks: two definitions, Seatbelt/bubblewrap/Windows, `claude -p`, a diagram, a table and a quiz). s4 is a two-block segment with no check and no objective.

Before practice, s3-steps works an example in four labelled subgoals with reasons (「コミットすれば、チーム全員に効きます」, 「`./` は今のフォルダー、`**` は下の階層すべて」) plus s3-code. p-deny then fades it (hint 「10-3の `keys/**` と同じ形です」). ex-target still gives no reason for its choice, and there is no partly blank example between the full example and the practice.

Every assessed segment has a scenario inline check (q1–q4), wrong-option feedback is complete, and the s3, s4, s5 sequence never goes two content sections without a check. Some items can still be answered by matching words: q2's key 「VMかクラウドセッションの中で開いて試す」 mirrors s2-table and s2-isolate, and its hint points at the VM box. e2-b repeats the s2-table cell 「ネットにつながらないコンテナやVM」, and e5 repeats the practice case whose answer practice-prompt-review expect spells out.

Each distractor encodes a misconception from the brief, and its feedback corrects it with a reason in two sentences or fewer. Examples: q2-b 「サンドボックスが守るのはシェルコマンドだけです」, q3-c (reads run without allow rules), e3-b and e3-d (`/` is not absolute, `./` is not home), e4-b 「拒否ルールは、どの権限モードでも効きます」, e5-b (`/usage` is an estimate), e6-a (`/compact` is a large request). The round-1 problems in the e3 and e4 corrections are gone.

s2-layers is a structural diagram with 5 nodes and 2 subgraphs, a takeaway caption (「サンドボックスが囲むのはシェルコマンドだけ」) and specific alt text, and the lesson has no images. Hooks are missing from the diagram, although s2-sandbox, e2-c and card-sandbox all say hooks run outside the sandbox. So the labels do not fully match the text.

The practice is an authentic audit of 田中さん's files and habits with three tasks (p-audit, p-deny, p-bill). Each task has an expect and a hint, and p-deny and p-bill also have a troubleshoot. There is a safe dummy folder, the model answers agree (practice-answer-rule and practice-prompt-review ③ both list `Read(./.env.*)`), and a four-item checklist closes it. The hint ladder has two levels at most, and p-audit has only one.

summary-points (3 points covering o1–o3) comes after the exam. summary-next now opens with a reflection question (「自分の環境で、田中さんと同じ状態になっているものはありますか。」) and names 第11回 as the next step. summary-cards has 7 cards, all on content the body teaches (card-clear is now backed by s5-table), and askTutor follows.

All 7 confirmed audit fixes are in the text: s1-auto 「2026年3月の公式記事の検証では」 and 「ターミナルとVS Codeの対話セッション」, s2-isolate and q2-c 「フックや `.mcp.json` のサーバー」, ex-place 「コミットすれば」, ex-verify 「Readツールや `cat` での読み取りが拒否されます」, and e2-d 「LinuxとmacOSでは…起動を拒否します」. The rebuilt e3 and e4 match the permissions page quoted in the brief (`~/path`, `//path`, scripts not covered). The version is pinned (v2.1.304) and every factual block cites a dated source.

The prose is in です・ます (「本番の変更は自分で確かめます。」), lint finds no banned phrases, and terms follow the glossary (拒否ルール, 利用上限, エフォート). Definitions and table cells use plain form, which is acceptable. The tone is terse rather than warm in places; the ja-editor owns wording.

The lesson is jp only and complete. The diagram labels are Japanese, the alt text is specific, and the link text is descriptive (「セキュリティの公式ドキュメント」, 「公式の料金ページ」). The brief says s2-layers was only parsed, not rendered in the reader, so its readability still needs the visual-qa screenshots.

niceToHave: q2 (s2-check) can be answered by matching the s2-table and s2-isolate wording, and its hint points at the answer. Replace the hint with 「フックやMCPサーバーまで囲めるのはどれか、考えましょう。」, or reframe the stem as a case: a repo whose `.claude/settings.json` defines a hook; which protection keeps that hook off your own machine?

e2's key 「ネットにつながらないコンテナやVMの中で使う」 repeats the s2-table cell word for word. Consider rewording it to 「外部とつながらないコンテナやVMに、Claude Codeごと入れて使う」 so that recalling the idea, not the phrase, is what is tested.

e5 repeats the practice case (nightly `claude -p`, an env key, an API bill), and practice-prompt-review expect states the answer. To move o3 to a new path, consider the interactive approval route: 「以前、起動時に表示されたAPIキーを使うかの質問で、使うを選んでいた」 → API charges, checked with `/status`. e1 still covers the contract's transfer item, so this is optional.
Add 「第6回｜CLAUDE.mdで前提を伝える」 and 「第7回｜手順はスキルに、調べものはサブエージェントに」 to prerequisites: CLAUDE.md, スキル and サブエージェント are used without a gloss (q1-d, s3-lead, s5-table, e6-c).

s2-layers leaves out hooks. Add a separate node inside VMBOX and outside SBOX, with no edge from C because hooks are not gated by permission rules, e.g. `F["リポジトリのフック
（サンドボックスの外）"]`. Then the diagram matches s2-sandbox, e2-c and card-sandbox (6 nodes).
ex-target (s3-steps) gives no reason for its choice. Consider md 「漏れると困る鍵のファイルを挙げます。Claudeが読んだ中身は、会話としてAnthropicに送られます。」 (this links to s4-lead, which already cites cc-sandbox-environments).
p-deny says 「Claude Codeを起動したら」, but no block shows when or how to start it. Consider md 「下のコマンドでダミーを作り、`.claude/settings.json` に拒否ルールを書きます。書けたら同じフォルダーで `claude` を起動し、結果を予想してから依頼文を送ります。」
s4 is not tied to any objective or action. Either add one sentence on what the learner should do with this fact, or fold s4-lead and s4-note into s2 after s2-isolate.
summary: The scope check required a full review (exit 1: 32 of 44 blocks changed, 52% of the lesson's parts), so all 13 criteria were scored fresh. All four round-1 must-fix items are gone: e3 now tests `Read(~/.aws/**)`, s3-pitfall teaches `~/` and `//`, e4-c no longer depends on `cat`, and the q3 explanation has no uncited Edit/Write claim. The 7 confirmed audit fixes are also in the text. The biggest strength is aligned, misconception-driven checks plus an authentic audit practice with model answers that agree. The most useful next step is to make q2 and e2 require reasoning rather than recall of the s2-table wording. Mean 3.38, all criteria ≥ 3, no must-fix.
